name: Adam McIntyre
source:
Adam McIntyre is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible and one of Your Character's love interests. His default name is "Adam McIntyre", but the player can pick a different name for him.

If Your Character accompanies him down to the beach in Chapter 1, he reveals that when he was on Season 9 of America's Most Eligible, he thought being on the show would give him more opportunities to travel to places he's never been to, and was looking forward to getting the chance to meet people he otherwise wouldn't have came across or approached outside of the competition. He confesses to being a total romantic when he first auditioned, and was hoping to make real connections with the other contestants, maybe even find a partner. 

In the beginning of the show, he urges Your Character to watch out for the other contestants and not to trust their producer; he tells Your Character that he doesn't want to see them get hurt.
